New tutorial: installing the free Awtrix NG firmware by Blueforcer on the Ulanzi TC002 Pixbar.

No cloud, no vendor app. MQTT discovery in Home Assistant, voice control through Assist via the rotary knob, scripts from the Awtrix Hub, and 11 blueprints to show your own sensors, calendar and weather on the 52x16 display.

https://youtu.be/b_JTOygN-Y0

#HomeAssistant #AwtrixNG #Ulanzi #SelfHosted #SmartHomeJunkie
